reason: Confirmed via conda-forge.yml on main: riscv64 not yet merged. Confirmed via direct diff of PR#171 vs main: the recipe's `# [linux and not aarch64]` source-URL selector for the linux-amd64 binary also matches riscv64, so the PR would repackage an x86-64 binary under the riscv64 label (wolfv's correctness concern is real). Upstream context: jgm/pandoc#10205 (closed, linked PR #10197 'linux/make_artifacts.sh: add riscv64 support' merged) means pandoc's release-build tooling can now produce riscv64 binaries, but none of the 5 most recent releases (3.10, 3.9.0.2, 3.9.0.1, 3.9, 3.8.3) actually ship one yet. PR#172 (wolfv, draft, v1 recipe migration) deliberately excludes riscv64 for the same reason -- consistent with our v1-bundling-avoidance policy, no separate action needed there. Direction is decided (wait for a real upstream riscv64 release, do not merge #171 as-is); nothing actionable in the feedstock until then. Re-check jgm/pandoc/releases periodically.
